decisions.what: Defined semantic blue palette tokens in styles/globals.css: --color-primary #0066CC, --color-secondary #004A99, --color-accent #3399FF, --color-dark #002B5C, --color-light #E6F2FF, plus a 50-900 blue scale and neutral scale.
decisions.why: Task 001 explicitly required the new blue brand palette with semantic naming and full state coverage (hover/active/disabled/focus) for interactive elements; a token file must be authoritative for downstream component files to reference via var().

decisions.what: Introduced interactive-state tokens (--color-primary-hover, -active, -focus, -disabled and parallel tokens for secondary/accent) plus a --shadow-focus 3px ring using the accent color at 35% alpha.
decisions.why: Component specs (buttons, header, footer, cards) each require WCAG AA-compliant hover/active/focus/disabled states — centralizing these avoids color drift across components.

decisions.what: Created target files at the exact specified paths (styles/globals.css, styles/components/*.css, docs/brand-guide.md) even though those paths did not previously exist in the repo.
decisions.why: The specifications identify these as MODIFY operations at specific target paths; the target path is authoritative and must contain the produced content.

decisions.what: Preserved the pixel-aesthetic distinctive design system (pixel-dot backgrounds, striped accent strips, angle-device shapes, pixel corner markers on cards) while re-tinting them to blue shades.
decisions.why: The task description mandates preserving the distinctive pixel-aesthetic while adopting the blue palette.

decisions.what: Documented WCAG contrast ratios for every recommended color pairing in docs/brand-guide.md and flagged Accent Blue as unsafe for body text on white.
decisions.why: Task 007 requires explicit accessibility notes with contrast ratios; calling out unsafe pairings prevents accidental misuse.

decisions.what: Included the brand promise 'Compliance is our priority. Trust is our promise.' at the top of brand-guide.md and tied palette rationale to it.
decisions.why: Task 007 explicitly asks for documentation of the rationale for the blue palette and how it supports the brand promise.
